path: 02_DESIGN_LANGUAGES_PHILOSOPHY_EXISTING\Design languages_\Narrative universe creation\New round\02_cosmic and mythic structures.docx
content:
designLanguageDocument:
  version: 1.0
  name: "Cosmic & Mythic Structures"
  stepNumber: 2
  intentions:
    purpose: "Define the universe’s fundamental rules and metaphysical frameworks—mythologies, cosmic forces, and pantheons—that translate the core theme into tangible guiding principles."
    values:
      - "CulturalRespect"
      - "ConceptualContinuity"
      - "SustainabilityOfLore"
      - "ThematicCoherence"
      - "MoralAlignment"
    scope: "Applies to all scales, defining the foundational laws and energies from which the universe springs, setting the stage for all stories and interactions."
    futureOrientation: "Cosmic and mythic elements can be refined as new story arcs emerge, allowing for the integration of fresh entities, revised creation myths, or altered metaphysical principles while preserving central integrity."
  coreComponents:
    lexicon:
      - concept: "CosmicForce"
        attributes: ["fundamental_energy", "defining_universal_principles", "influential_power"]
      - concept: "MythicChronicle"
        attributes: ["creation_narrative", "epic_legend_anchor", "symbolic_events"]
      - concept: "DimensionalThreshold"
        attributes: ["boundary_between_realms", "access_points_for_mystical_interactions", "rules_of_passage"]
    patterns:
      - pattern: "MythicUnity"
        description: "All cosmic stories form a cohesive mythic tapestry, resonating with the central theme."
      - pattern: "SymbolicForces"
        description: "Deities, energies, or abstract principles represent archetypal concepts like creation, destruction, or wisdom."
      - pattern: "EternalCycles"
        description: "Recurring patterns (e.g., birth/death, seasons) give structure to myth and reinforce the universe’s intrinsic flow of time."
    masterKey:
      integrators:
        - integrator: "CentralMyth"
          role: "A core creation narrative or cosmic event influences all fundamental laws and interpretations of origin."
        - integrator: "InterwovenRealms"
          role: "Different dimensions, planes, or afterlives connect logically, ensuring a cohesive metaphysical system."
        - integrator: "HarmonicBalance"
          role: "Opposing forces (chaos/order, light/dark) maintain a dynamic equilibrium, driving narrative conflict and development."
  guidelines:
    textNarratives:
      - "Refer to the CentralMyth in all origin stories, aligning local legends with cosmic fundamentals."
      - "Maintain consistent terminology for cosmic entities and dimensional boundaries, avoiding contradictory naming across various media."
    visualConcepts:
      - "Represent cosmic forces symbolically through recurring colors, geometric patterns, or light/shadow motifs."
      - "Use stable iconography (e.g., stylized sun discs, star patterns) for each divine entity."
    interactiveDesign:
      - "In interactive mediums, let user experiences with dimensional thresholds or cosmic cycles reveal a sense of universe-scale stakes and purpose."
      - "Ensure that feedback loops reflect the universe’s rules and allow users to comprehend the subtle impacts of their actions."
  implementationStrategies:
    - "Maintain a master cosmology document that acts as the foundation for all mythic references."
    - "Update cosmic and mythic references as stories expand into new regions or eras."
    - "Use user feedback or analytical insights to refine metaphysical rules over time, ensuring narrative consistency and ethical considerations remain aligned."
